extName.description: 商店 listing 的标题。品牌词 + 品类词：应用店基本只按名字排，名字里不含 bookmark/书签就拿不到搜索流量。窄处显示的是 extShortName。

extShortName.description: manifest short_name，上限 12 字符。Chrome 侧栏顶栏、扩展列表这些窄处用它，否则长名会被截断。

extDescription.message: Reorganize your Chrome bookmarks with AI — every change is previewed, confirmed, and undoable

dashEmptyBookmarks.message: No http(s) bookmarks to rank yet.

dashEmptyVisits.message: No browsing history to rank yet.

dashHistoryExplain.message: Ranking sites by visits means reading your browsing history. Chrome will now ask for permission to "read your browsing history." Reshelve only counts visits per site, on this computer. If you never press this button it is never requested.

dashHistoryDenied.message: Permission not granted. You can turn it on later in the extension settings.

dashDomainExpand.message: Show folders and bookmark contents for $domain$

dashDomainCollapse.message: Hide folders and bookmark contents for $domain$

dashVisitSavedLabel.message: Visited pages of $domain$ that are bookmarked

dashVisitUnsavedLabel.message: Visited pages of $domain$ that are not bookmarked

dashVisitNoneSaved.message: None of the visited pages are in your bookmarks.

dashVisitNoneUnsaved.message: Every visited page is already bookmarked.

transferIntro.message: Search bookmarks or folders, export a selection, or move selected bookmarks into an existing or new folder.

settingsLangBody.message: Sets both the interface language and the language of newly created folder names.

moveRefreshError.message: Bookmarks moved, but the list could not refresh. Reopen this page to see the latest tree.

moveErrEmptySelection.message: No bookmarks were selected to move.

moveErrMissingBookmark.message: Some selected bookmarks no longer exist. Refresh and try again.

moveErrMissingTarget.message: The destination folder does not exist.

moveErrEmptyFolderName.message: The new folder name cannot be empty.

moveErrMissingParent.message: The parent folder for the new folder does not exist.

scopeNeedModel.message: Reshelve files your bookmarks with an AI model of your own, and there is not one yet. Pick a preset, paste an API key, and that is the whole setup.

scopeIntro.message: Check the folders you want Reshelve to reorganize.

logCleanupScanDone.message: Scan done: $groups$ duplicate groups, $folders$ empty folders

logCleanupDone.message: Cleanup done: deleted $deleted$ bookmarks and $folders$ folders, moved $moved$

cleanupIntro.message: None of these cleanups uses a model. Only the dead-link check makes network requests, and only once you start it.

cleanupAggregateExplain.message: Enter part of a title or URL, review the matches, then move the selected bookmarks into one folder. Matching stays local, uses no model, and does not visit the URLs.

cleanupAggregateNoMatches.message: No bookmark title or URL contains that text.

cleanupAggregateParentSearchPlaceholder.message: Type a path or search existing folders

cleanupAggregateParentUseTyped.message: Press Enter to use this path

cleanupAggregateParentHint.message: Type a path or choose from the list. Missing folders will be created.

cleanupAggregateAlreadyThereOne.message: $count$ more was already in the target folder and was not moved again.

cleanupAggregateAlreadyThereOther.message: $count$ more were already in the target folder and were not moved again.

cleanupStaleExplain.message: Find long-unused bookmarks in the current scope from each bookmark's last-opened time recorded by Chrome. Browsing history is not read.

cleanupStaleEmpty.message: No long-unvisited bookmarks were found in the current scope.

cleanupStaleCutoffs.message: Last opened before: 3 months $three$; 6 months $six$; 1 year $year$; 2 years $twoYears$

cleanupStaleUnknownHint.message: Chrome did not provide a last-opened time for this bookmark, so its unused duration is unknown

cleanupStaleGroupDeleteAll.message: Mark every bookmark in $folder$ for deletion

cleanupLinksStart.message: Start checking (requires access to all websites)

cleanupLinksExplain.message: Checking whether a link still exists means actually visiting it. Chrome will now ask for permission to "read your data on all websites" — that is the only wording it has for this. If you never press this button it is never requested, and the other two cleanups are unaffected.

cleanupLinksDenied.message: Permission not granted, so this is skipped. The other two still work.

cleanupGroupNormalizedHint.message: Identical only after ignoring fragments, trailing slashes, and tracking parameters. Unchecked by default — please look.

cleanupGroupSuspectHint.message: 403 is usually anti-bot, 401 just needs a login, 5xx means the server is having a bad day, 429 means we asked too fast, and a timeout may just be your connection. None of these are deleted — they are listed only.

cleanupDeadActionHint.message: Dead links often point at old addresses of your own writing, still recoverable from archive.org. Deleting makes that permanent.

cleanupOverwriteUndoWarning.message: Running this will make the last AI organize impossible to undo.

sendErrChannelClosed.message: The background stopped before returning a result (the extension was just reloaded, or the browser suspended it). Finished batches are cached, so a retry is much faster.

sendErrContextInvalidated.message: The extension was reloaded, so this side panel is stale. Close it and open it again.

sendErrNoReceiver.message: Cannot reach the background. Make sure Reshelve is enabled at chrome://extensions, then reopen the side panel.

sendErrNoResponse.message: The background returned nothing — it may have been suspended.

importDuplicates.message: $count$ of them are already in your bookmarks

importDeleteHint.message: Do not want it? Just delete that folder in Chrome.

settingsPresetHint.message: Pick a provider, or fill it in yourself

settingsEndpointOpencodeNote.message: OpenCode Go is aimed at coding-agent traffic; bookmark classification over it is best-effort. If connection tests keep failing, switch to a model vendor's direct endpoint (Zhipu, Kimi, ...).

settingsEndpointCustomHint.message: Fill in the base URL and key

settingsModelNone.message: No models yet. Once the key is saved, "Add a model" lists what this provider offers.

settingsBaseUrlFull.message: The address only needs to end at /v1 — Reshelve appends /chat/completions itself, so pasting the full endpoint from the docs doubles it up.

settingsPrivacyKey.message: Every API key you enter is stored in plain text in local browser storage and never uploaded anywhere; deleting an endpoint deletes its key with it.

settingsPrivacyPayload.message: Only bookmark titles, domains, paths, and current folder names are sent to the model — never URL parameters or page contents.

settingsTestFailAuth.message: The API key was rejected. Check it in your provider's console, or issue a new one.

settingsTestFailModel.message: The provider does not recognize this model name. Look up the name currently in use in its docs.

settingsTestFailFormat.message: The endpoint responded, but this model will not answer in the format Reshelve needs. Try another model.

settingsTestFailNetwork.message: The request never got through. Check your proxy or VPN, and whether another extension is blocking it.

settingsTestFailSession.message: The request reached the gateway but was rejected (missing session). Not a network failure. Test again; if it keeps happening, use the model vendor's own endpoint.

settingsTestFailUpstream.message: The provider failed or rate-limited the request. Try again in a moment, or pick another model on this endpoint.

settingsTestFailRegion.message: This model is not available in your region, or needs to be enabled in the provider console. The API key is fine.

settingsTestFailPermission.message: Reshelve does not have permission to reach this domain yet. Click Test connection again and allow it.

settingsTestFailUnknown.message: The test did not finish, so there is no verdict on what went wrong. Try again.

prefsModeAdditiveBody.message: No existing folder is renamed, merged, or deleted. Bookmarks that fit nowhere are gathered into new folders by topic; the ones that can't even be given a topic land in an "Other" folder. The whole run can be undone.

prefsModeRebuild.message: These bookmarks have no usable structure yet, so this run redesigns the whole folder tree.

prefsModeRebuildBody.message: Old folders left out of this design are numbered after this round's folders and sort after them, with their contents untouched; the exception is a folder whose name genuinely starts with a digit, which keeps it so your own naming is not clipped. A final pass then numbers any folder that is still missing a prefix.

prefsGithubOnlyBody.message: Only bookmarks in the current scope that match the selected rules and need a new title are included. No model call, bookmark move, folder change, or empty-folder cleanup is performed; review each rename before applying, and undo remains available.

prefsGithubOnlyCount.message: $count$ bookmarks in this scope will be renamed by the selected rules.

prefsGithubOnlyPreview.message: The next step shows the rename list first, so you can accept or reject each item.

prefsCleanSummary.message: Deletes folders in scope that hold no bookmarks. Merging several folders is an exception: the source folders are always cleaned up regardless of this switch, and undo still restores them.

prefsCleanBody.message: This also covers parents that become empty once their subfolders are cleared. Scope roots are never deleted. Undo restores the folders too.

prefsLooseOnlyBody.message: Choosing "File into existing folders" reclassifies every bookmark in scope on every run — that's what catches a bookmark that's already in a folder but filed wrong, at the cost of running classification over everything each time (cached ones aside). This option saves that cost, but a misfiled bookmark won't be corrected automatically anymore — move it by hand, or switch back to "File into existing folders" for one full pass.

prefsLooseListEmpty.message: Nothing in this scope sits directly loose, outside every folder.

settingsGithubBody.message: Rewrites titles from the URL into "repo (owner)", keeping the file name when a specific file is bookmarked. This changes the bookmark's own name, not just its location, and can be undone. However this round is organized, the switch stands on its own: while it is on, every GitHub bookmark in scope is rewritten.

prefsPermissionNotice.message: Reshelve asked for no network permission at install time. Only when analysis starts does it ask the browser for access to the model domain you entered.

structureIntroOne.message: The AI designed $folders$ top-level folder to hold $bookmarks$ bookmarks.

structureIntroOther.message: The AI designed $folders$ top-level folders to hold $bookmarks$ bookmarks.

structureHint.message: Rename or delete any folder you do not want, then continue to the move list. Numbering is reassigned automatically.

structureMergeNotice.message: $names$ will be emptied and deleted, and all their bookmarks move into the folder above. One click undoes the whole run and puts those folders back.

structureFallback.message: Delete a top-level folder and its bookmarks fall back to "Other"; delete a subfolder and they stay in its parent. Merging a top-level folder removes its subfolders too, and its bookmarks move into the folder you chose.

reviewSummaryOne.message: $total$ suggested move, $accepted$ selected. Unselected bookmarks stay where they are.

reviewSummaryOther.message: $total$ suggested moves, $accepted$ selected. Unselected bookmarks stay where they are.

reviewTitleOnlyEmpty.message: Nothing in this scope has a title that can be normalized.

titleRuleGithubReason.message: Build repo (owner) from the URL; keep a short path for files.

titleRuleGitlabReason.message: Build project · group from the last two URL segments.

titleRuleNpmReason.message: Build package (npm) from the package URL.

titleRulePypiReason.message: Build package (PyPI) from the project URL.

titleRuleDockerReason.message: Build image (Docker) from the image URL and keep the namespace.

titleRuleHuggingfaceReason.message: Build name (owner) from a model or dataset URL; mark datasets.

titleRuleArxivReason.message: Take the paper id from the URL; keep [id] Title when a real title exists, otherwise id (arXiv).

titleRuleYoutubeReason.message: Strip the YouTube prefix and keep the original title.

titleRuleCsdnReason.message: Strip the CSDN prefix and keep the original title.

titleRuleZhihuReason.message: Strip the Zhihu prefix and keep the original title.

titleRuleJuejinReason.message: Strip the Juejin prefix and keep the original title.

titleRuleBilibiliReason.message: Strip the Bilibili prefix and keep the original title.

titleRuleMediumReason.message: Strip Medium site affixes and keep the original title.

titleRuleDevtoReason.message: Strip DEV Community site affixes and keep the original title.

reviewRenameFoldersOne.message: , and add a number prefix to $count$ existing folder (undoable)

reviewRenameFoldersOther.message: , and add number prefixes to $count$ existing folders (undoable)

reviewRenameBookmarksOne.message: $count$ GitHub bookmark title will also be normalized to "repo (owner)". That is controlled by a setting and is not affected by the checkboxes below.

reviewRenameBookmarksOther.message: $count$ GitHub bookmark titles will also be normalized to "repo (owner)". That is controlled by a setting and is not affected by the checkboxes below.

reviewCleanNote.message: Empty folders in scope will be cleaned up afterwards (undoable).

reviewEmpty.message: The AI thinks every bookmark in scope is already in a sensible place, so there is nothing to move. Try a messier folder — or, if this run was judged as filing into existing folders, discard it below, scan again, and pick "Not right — redesign it" before starting.

reviewStrandNote.message: Leaving this bookmark here keeps the folder "$folder$" around.

reviewGroupSelectAll.message: Select or deselect the whole "$label$" group

reviewUnchangedNoTarget.message: No suitable folder found, left where it was

reviewUnchangedFailed.message: Couldn't be classified this time, left where it was

resultFailedHint.message: Everything already applied can be fully undone with the button below.

resultTreeHint.message: The real bookmark tree. The number on the right is how many bookmarks that folder holds, including subfolders. Unselected moves were not applied, so those bookmarks are still where they were.

resultUndoneOne.message: Undo complete: $restored$ item restored, $folders$ created folders removed.

resultUndoneOther.message: Undo complete: $restored$ items restored, $folders$ created folders removed.

errTaskRunning.message: A task is already running in the background. Watch or cancel it from any Reshelve side panel.

errClearTaskFailed.message: Couldn't clear the task record. Reopen the panel to continue.

errBackgroundRecycled.message: The browser suspended the background and interrupted this run.

errHostPermission.message: Reshelve needs permission to reach your model endpoint's domain. Retry and allow the permission.

errNoApiKey.message: No API key configured yet. Add one in Settings first.

errNoTargetFolders.message: No usable target folders in the selected scope. Pick a scope that contains subfolders and try again.

errNoLooseBookmarks.message: "Only classify loose bookmarks" is on, but nothing in the selected scope sits directly loose, outside every folder. Turn the option off to reclassify everything in scope.

errNoAlternativeFolders.message: After excluding each selected bookmark's current folder, there are no other candidate folders left.

errNoBookmarksBar.message: Cannot find the bookmarks bar, so importing is not possible.

errImportInvalidJson.message: This file is not valid JSON.

errImportUnsupportedFormat.message: This is not a Reshelve export, or its version is not supported.

errClassifyAllFailed.message:
AI analysis failed — no bookmark could be classified.
$reason$

logAnalyzeStart.message: Analysis started: reading the bookmark tree

logDuplicateFolders.message: $count$ duplicate-named folders in this scope were folded away, leaving only the first of each name as a candidate — to the model they were the same line, and offering them all would only scatter related bookmarks

logModeAdditive.message: These bookmarks are already organized — this run only files them into existing folders: $reason$

logModeRebuild.message: These bookmarks have no usable structure yet — this run redesigns the whole folder tree: $reason$

logModeOverriddenRebuild.message: Redesigning the whole folder tree as you asked — the automatic judgment is skipped this run (it would have said: $reason$)

logModeOverriddenAdditive.message: Filing bookmarks into existing folders as you asked — the automatic judgment is skipped this run (it would have said: $reason$)

logTreeStart.message: Designing folders from the tags of $count$ bookmarks

logTreeDone.message: Folder design complete: $new$ new folders created, $reused$ existing folders reused

logShapeCompared.message: Derived from the bookmark count: $wanted$ top-level folders, $depth$ level(s); actually built $actual$

logPrunedSmall.message: Dropped $count$ folders holding fewer than $min$ bookmarks; their bookmarks moved up one level

logReviewCollapsed.message: Removed $count$ folder(s) sharing a name with the folder above them; their contents moved up one level

logDeepenStart.message: "$title$" holds $count$ bookmarks, over the per-folder limit of $max$; splitting it by topic

logDeepenNoTopics.message: "$title$" holds $count$ bookmarks, but they map to only $topics$ topic(s), so a second subfolder cannot be cut; left as is

logDeepenRetag.message: "$title$" holds $count$ bookmarks but not enough topics; re-extracting labels to split it

logDeepenNoSplit.message: "$title$" holds $count$ bookmarks, but the designed subfolders did not separate them; left as is

warnOversizedFolder.message: "$title$" holds $count$ bookmarks, over the recommended limit; browsing it one by one will be tedious

warnStrandedLeftovers.message: "$title$" already has subfolders, yet $count$ bookmarks still sit loose at this level — more than any one subfolder holds, so this level is hard to work through

warnFallbackShare.message: "Other" holds $count$ bookmarks, $percent$% of the scope, past the $limit$% red line — the folder design did not cover this library, and whole topics were pushed in there

logPromotedFallback.message: $count$ families inside "Other" stand on their own and were promoted to the top level: $detail$

warnTopSiblingsJudgment.message: $count$ top-level folders, over the recommended $limit$ — more than one screenful, so finding things degrades into scanning one by one

warnTopSiblingsProduct.message: $count$ top-level folders, past even the hard limit of $limit$ — consider merging a few related topics

logRehomeStart.message: $count$ bookmarks lost their folder; looking for the best home among the folders that survived

logRehomeDone.message: $count$ of them found a better folder; the rest stay where pruning put them

logMergeNameFailed.message: Could not name the merged folder, using "$name$"

logClassifyLooseOnly.message: "Only classify loose bookmarks" is on: classifying $loose$ bookmarks that sit directly loose under the scope root; $infolder$ bookmarks already inside a folder are left untouched this round

logReclassifyStart.message: Reclassifying $count$ bookmarks, each with its current target folder excluded, against $candidates$ remaining candidates

logReclassifyDone.message: Reclassify done: $changed$ moved to a new folder, $unchanged$ still had nothing better

logClassifyFailed.message: $count$ bookmarks failed to classify and were left in place. Reason: $reason$

logNewFoldersStart.message: $count$ bookmarks fit no existing folder; naming new folders

logNewFoldersNone.message: $count$ bookmarks fit no existing folder and gave no usable topic name either

logNewFoldersMultiRoot.message: Multiple scope roots selected; new folders are all created under "$root$"

logNewFoldersGrouped.message: $count$ topics were left alone because those bookmarks already sit together in one folder

logNewFoldersNameCollision.message: $count$ topics' names collided with an existing folder and were skipped; those bookmarks stay in place

logNewFoldersCapped.message: $count$ topics exceeded the per-level cap and got no folder of their own

logNewFoldersFallback.message: $count$ bookmarks had no usable topic name; placed in "Other"

logTitleRewrites.message: $count$ GitHub bookmark titles will be normalized

logApplyDone.message: Reorganization complete: $executed$ steps run, $removed$ empty folders removed, $sorted$ folders renumbered

logApplyInterrupted.message: Reorganization interrupted: $executed$ steps run, $removed$ empty folders removed, $sorted$ folders renumbered

logUndoDone.message: Undo complete: $restored$ items restored, $folders$ new folders removed

logCancelRequested.message: Cancellation requested — finishing the current batch…
